parsed.answer: For the next Cobalt outage, Ivo should use REPLAY-1-632, the recovery procedure tested on August 8 that restored missing updates. The delivery-mode change was prompted by the GATE-1-519 outages recorded on August 8; Ivo approved switching Cobalt from BATCH-1-741 to STREAM-1-286 on August 15. The August 8 meeting itself did not approve a delivery-mode change.

citations.quote: The team tested REPLAY-1-632, which restored the missing updates. No change of delivery mode was approved at this meeting.
The delivery choice made on August 15, 2026, is to remain in force.

Ivo approved switching Cobalt from BATCH-1-741 to STREAM-1-286. This supersedes the August 1 delivery decision. The cause was the GATE-1-519 outages recorded on August 8; keep the successful recovery procedure from that incident.
Ivo reported that BATCH-1-741 lost updates during GATE-1-519 outages.
